class.name: IfcCurtainWall
class.brief_description: Definition from ISO 6707-1:1989 : Non load bearing wall positioned on the outside of a building and enclosing it. A curtain wall is an exterior wall of a building which is an assembly of components, hung from the edge of the floor/roof structure rather than bearing on a floor. Curtain wall is represented as a building element assembly and implemented as a subtype of IfcBuildingElement that uses an

members.member: Predefined generic type for a curtain wall that is specified in an enumeration. There may be a property set given specificly for the predefined types. NOTE The PredefinedType shall only be used, if no type object IfcCurtainWallType is assigned, providing its own IfcCurtainWallType.PredefinedType . IFC2x4 CHANGE The attribute has been added at the end of the entity definition.
